scope: read-only diagnosis; no motion or deployment performed

storage.write_path: synchronous unbuffered acquisition journal inside MCU receive/transmit loop; journal data imported into MCAP, processed ROS images recorded too

confirmed_code_issue: base_io.motor_sample treats any nonzero RoboClaw status as motor_fault and returns before wheel_states publication; persistent 0x01000000 is documented Speed Error Limit Warning, not a low-bit driver fault. Investigate warning cause separately from status classification.
inference: Recording I/O and CPU load plausibly starve producer loops; synchronous journal path directly allows storage stalls to delay MCU servicing. SD throughput saturation alone is not proven without recording-time disk latency/CPU profiling or controlled A/B.
next_fixes: Separate acquisition/control loops from synchronous storage writes; bound buffers and explicitly report overflow.
Avoid simultaneous duplicate large image serialization/storage; lower recording camera fps to match normal 5 fps unless full rate is required.
Decode RoboClaw errors/warnings separately; preserve feedback publication with status flags; diagnose persistent speed error limit warning.
